strings.已打开 · 最近使用的应用在左侧: On · recent apps on the left

strings.\nAtrium 正以低完整性级别运行，不能写入用户目录。请把 Atrium 解: Atrium is running at low integrity and cannot write to your profile. Unzip it to an ordinary folder (such as D:\\Atrium), make sure Atrium.exe has no Low integrity label, then start it again.
strings.主任务栏和打开了窗口的任务栏: Main taskbar and taskbars with open windows
strings.在所有显示器上显示任务栏: Show the taskbar on all displays
strings.QQ 等发出系统通知的应用。需要在 Windows 隐私设置中允许访问通知。: Apps that send system notifications, such as QQ. Allow notification access in Windows privacy settings.
strings.关闭后用回 Windows 自己的任务栏和通知横幅；小组件和台前调度不受影响。: Turned off, Windows' own taskbar and notification banners come back; widgets and Stage Manager are not affected.
strings.前面的应用留在屏幕中间，其他应用的窗口斜立在屏幕一侧，各带阴影和应用图标。: The app in front stays in the middle; other apps' windows stand at an angle at the side, each with its shadow and app icon.
strings.卡片只显示应用和标题；通知窗口同时不会出现在截图和屏幕共享里。: Cards show only the app and the title; the notification window is also excluded from screen capture and sharing.
strings.只留下 Atrium 栏。关闭开关或退出 Atrium 时恢复；Win 键等系统: Keep only the Atrium bar. Windows' taskbar returns when this is turned off or Atrium quits; system shortcuts such as the Windows key keep working.
strings.只读微信窗口里的会话列表，有新的未读消息时显示卡片；免打扰的会话不提醒。: Reads the chat list in WeChat's window; cards appear for new unread messages. Muted chats are ignored.
strings.只读飞书弹窗里的文字，同时显示为卡片；点击卡片打开飞书。: Reads the text of Feishu popups and shows it as a card; clicking the card opens Feishu.
strings.固定的应用之后，显示正在运行的其他应用，下方带一个小圆点。: After pinned apps, other running apps appear with a small dot below.
strings.在栏的右端，使用系统的时间与日期格式。: At the right end of the bar, using the system's time and date format.
strings.开启后，其他屏幕的任务栏隐藏系统托盘、状态圆环、时钟日期和通知按钮。: On, the taskbars on other displays hide the tray, status ring, clock and notifications.
strings.打开 Windows 的“请勿打扰”；通知照常显示为 Atrium 卡片。关闭开: Turns on Windows' Do Not Disturb; notifications still appear as Atrium cards. Restored when turned off or Atrium quits.
strings.拖动可移动，拖下角可改变大小，右键可移除。: Drag to move, drag the lower corner to resize, right-click to remove.
strings.玻璃栏随内容伸缩，像一枚贴合物品的胶囊；关闭后固定为“最大宽度”。: The glass bar grows with its content, like a capsule around its items; off, it is fixed at Maximum width.
strings.登录 Windows 时启动 Atrium。: Start Atrium when you sign in to Windows.
strings.背景随鼠标位置向上拱起，幅度跟随任务栏的悬停放大设置。: The background rises under the pointer; the amount follows the taskbar's hover magnification.
strings.像 macOS Dock 一样，在另一块屏幕底边停留即可唤出任务栏；也可以固定显: Like the macOS Dock, rest the pointer at another display's bottom edge to bring up the taskbar; it can also be fixed to a display.
strings.加入当前这一组，之后一起收起、一起回来。: Add to the current group; they are put away and brought back together.
strings.卡片从边缘滑出，浮在窗口上面；指针离开后收回。: Cards slide in from the edge above the windows and go back when the pointer leaves.
strings.小组件和台前调度留在这块屏幕上，不随任务栏移动。其他屏幕的窗口照常使用。: Widgets and Stage Manager stay on this display and do not follow the taskbar. Windows on other displays work as usual.
strings.当使用多个显示器时，在以下位置显示我的任务栏应用: When using multiple displays, show my taskbar apps on
strings.换到前面，原来前面的应用收进一侧。: Bring to the front; the app that was in front moves to the side.
strings.点“添加应用…”选择一个程序，或一键导入 Windows 任务栏上已固定的应用。: Choose a program with Add app…, or import the apps pinned to the Windows taskbar.
strings.界面字体：MiSans，版权归小米科技有限责任公司，依《MiSans 字体知识产: Interface font: MiSans, copyright Xiaomi Inc., used under the MiSans Font Intellectual Property License Agreement.
strings.运行标记和窗口预览遵循此规则；固定应用始终保留。主任务栏指系统主显示器上的 At: Running indicators and window previews follow this rule; pinned apps always stay. The main taskbar is Atrium's taskbar on the system's primary display.
strings.默认跟随任务栏；主屏右上角模式下，新通知弹入，已有通知向下让位。: Follows the taskbar by default; in the primary top-right mode, new notifications slide in and existing ones move down.
strings.另一位置的 Atrium 正在运行，未连接本目录中的核心。: Atrium is running from another location; the core in this folder was not connected.
strings.核心回复过大: The core's reply was too large
strings.核心未响应或连接已中断，尚未确认运行状态。: The core did not respond or the connection was lost; the running state is not confirmed.
strings.核心连接已中断，尚未确认保存结果。请重新连接后检查已保存的设置。: The connection to the core was lost; the save result is not confirmed. Reconnect and check the saved settings.
strings.核心未在期限内回复或连接已关闭，尚未确认操作结果。请重新连接。: The core did not reply in time or the connection closed; the result is not confirmed. Please reconnect.
strings.该开机启动项属于另一位置的 Atrium: That startup entry belongs to Atrium in another location
strings.无法连接本目录中的核心：{0}: Could not connect to the core in this folder: {0}
strings.设置已保存，但未能修改 Windows 开机启动：{0}。请重新切换开机启动后再: Settings were saved, but Windows startup could not be changed: {0}. Toggle Start with Windows again, then save.
strings.闭式弹簧，阻尼比 0.62；切成 12 段 Hermite 曲线交给 Direc: Closed-form spring, damping ratio 0.62; split into 12 Hermite segments for DirectComposition
strings.状态圆环：电量、音量与亮度: Status ring: battery, volume and brightness
strings.滚轮翻看通知后吸附到一张: Scrolling through notifications snaps to one
strings.换页、淡入、列表依次出现、字色渐变: Page changes, fades, staggered lists, ink shifts
strings.1 − e^(−rate · t)，每帧从当前值继续: 1 − e^(−rate · t), continuing from the current value each frame
strings.sin²(πt / 0.48)，起跳与落地都没有速度突变: sin²(πt / 0.48); no velocity jump at takeoff or landing
strings.点开任务栏上的应用：只跳一次: Opening a taskbar app: one hop only
strings.小组件到屏幕边缘、区块之间: Widgets to the screen edge, between sections
strings.不超过栏高的一半：默认是胶囊形: At most half the bar height: a capsule by default
strings.与栏相同，8 到栏高 / 2: Same as the bar, 8 to height / 2
strings.面板与栏是同一种材质、同一种形状: Popup and bar share one material and one shape
strings.面板很圆时，模块不跟着变成胶囊: A very round panel does not turn its modules into capsules
strings.同心：外层圆角减去边距: Concentric: outer radius minus the inset
strings.约为边长的 13%，与 macOS 小组件相同: About 13% of the side, as macOS widgets
strings.G3 连续端部；圆形旋钮保持正圆: G3 continuous ends; round knobs stay circular
strings.不超过所在容器圆角减去边距: At most the container radius minus the inset
strings.同一个着色器、两组参数：液态玻璃只在边缘折射、中间几乎透明；磨砂玻璃把背景磨成色: One shader, two parameter sets: liquid glass refracts only at the rim and is almost clear in the middle; frosted glass blurs the backdrop into colour fields and hardly refracts. Drag the divider left and right to compare.
strings.统一 G3 连续圆角，保持大圆角与胶囊比例。: One G3 continuous corner system, keeping the large radii and capsule proportions.
strings.MiSans 三个字重。一个界面最多三档字号；主次先用透明度区分，再用字号，最后: Three MiSans weights. At most three sizes per screen; hierarchy first uses opacity, then size, then weight; all figures are tabular.
strings.间距只用一组刻度；颜色只有一个强调色，其余都是中性灰。玻璃上的字色由背后的亮度决: One spacing scale; one accent colour, everything else neutral grey. Ink on glass follows the brightness behind it.
strings.把指针移到任务栏上：图标像波浪一样依次变大（倍数取当前设置）；点一个图标，看启动: Move the pointer over the taskbar: icons grow in a wave (the current magnification); click an icon to see the launch hop. Click a notification card to bring it back.
strings.动画可从当前位置改向，并按实际时间推进；弹簧保留速度，小组件缓出目前会重启。点卡: Animations can change direction from where they are and advance in real time; springs keep velocity, while the widgets' ease-out currently restarts. Click a card to play.
strings.动画的曲线与时长、材质预设的每个参数、字号与字重、圆角与间距：与 Atrium: Animation curves and durations, every material preset value, sizes and weights, corners and spacing: the same values Atrium runs with.
strings.弹簧按 Apple 的方式给出：时长与回弹（= 1 − 阻尼比）。弹出动画由 D: Springs are given Apple's way: duration and bounce (= 1 − damping ratio). Popup animations play in DirectComposition; the rest are computed per frame by the render thread on the composition clock.
strings.两个预设与当前设置。栏、弹出面板与小组件用同一个着色器（glass.hlsl）和: Two presets and the current settings. The bar, popups and widgets share one shader (glass.hlsl) and one parameter set.
strings.字重从不合成：样式选择字体文件。MiSans 的字重比名称细一档：Medium: Weights are never synthesized: the style picks a font file. MiSans's weights sit one step below their names: Medium 380 as regular, Demibold 450 as medium, Semibold 520 as semibold.
strings.统一解析 G3 轮廓：直边接点的曲率、曲率变化率均为零。卡片 24，按钮按半高取: Every outline resolves as G3: curvature and its rate are zero where straight edges meet. Cards 24, buttons take half their height; circles keep constant curvature.
strings.先把分辨率换算成逻辑宽度（像素 ÷ 缩放），再查栏的尺寸。图标是栏高的一半，栏高: Resolution becomes logical width (pixels ÷ scale), then the bar's size is chosen. Icons are half the bar height; the bar is about 6% of the logical screen height.
strings.由玻璃背后的亮度决定：高于 0.50 用深色字，低于 0.42 换回浅色字，两者: Decided by the brightness behind the glass: above 0.50 dark ink, below 0.42 light ink, with no switch in between; a 450 ms ease-out crossfade on change. Ink has three opacity levels.
strings.玻璃是承载内容的介质。字色跟随背后的亮度，装饰的强度以文字始终清晰为限。: Glass carries content. Ink follows the brightness behind it; decoration stays within what keeps text legible.
strings.可以中途改向，保持位置连续；弹簧保留速度，小组件缓出目前会重启。: It can change direction mid-flight with continuous position; springs keep velocity, while the widgets' ease-out currently restarts.
strings.同一类元素用同一条曲线、同一个圆角、同一档字号。: The same kind of element uses one curve, one radius and one type size.
strings.嵌套：内圆角随边距缩小，保持一致的轮廓。: Nesting: the inner radius shrinks with the inset, keeping the outline consistent.
strings.波形：(1 + cos πd) / 2，d 为指针到图标的距离（以 2.3 个图: Wave: (1 + cos πd) / 2, where d is the pointer's distance in icons (radius 2.3 icons); magnification comes from the Taskbar page.
strings.点我，再弹出一次。: Click me to show it again.
strings.弹簧 kPop：从 0.92 倍放大到 1，只越过一点点（峰值 1.0067），: Spring kPop: from 0.92 to 1, overshooting only slightly (peak 1.0067), fading in over 160 ms. No back-and-forth bounce.
strings.玻璃之下，内容优先 Aa 0123: Under the glass, content first Aa 0123
strings.内圆角随边距缩小，直边间距一致。: Inner radii shrink with the inset; straight-edge spacing stays even.
strings.这块屏幕：{0} × {1} 像素，缩放 {2:0}% → 逻辑宽度 {3:0}: This screen: {0} × {1} pixels, scale {2:0}% → logical width {3:0}. Suggested bar height {4}, icons {5}; currently bar height {6:0}, icons {7:0}.
strings.未连接的显示器（暂用主屏，重连后恢复）: Disconnected display (using the primary until it returns)
strings.所选显示器已断开，当前使用主屏；重新连接后会自动恢复。: The chosen display is disconnected; the primary is used and the choice returns when it reconnects.
strings.显示器断开时自动回到主屏，保留选择供重新连接后恢复。: Falls back to the primary when a display disconnects, keeping the choice for reconnection.

strings.设为 {0:0}，不超过高度的一半: Set to {0:0}, at most half the height
strings.明天的活动时间定了吗？我这边上午都有空，下午三点以后也可以。: Is tomorrow's time set? I'm free all morning, or after 3 pm.
strings.台前调度已关闭：窗口照常叠放在桌面上: Stage Manager is off: windows stack on the desktop as usual
strings.把指针移到预览的{0}边缘，卡片滑出；点按换到前面，按住 Shift 点按加入这: Rest the pointer at the preview's {0} edge to slide the cards out; click to bring one forward, Shift-click to add it to this group
